test_inputs.explanation: The admin_base_url is taken from the visited URLs (http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/...). The attribute_code, frontend_label and scope were extracted from the base64 filter in the URL: YXR0cmlidXRlX2NvZGU9Y29sb3ImZnJvbnRlbmRfbGFiZWw9Q29sb3ImaXNfZ2xvYmFsPTE= which decodes to "attribute_code=color&frontend_label=Color&is_global=1" (is_global=1 corresponds to the visible scope 'Global').
